name: MutantXL fixed-degree fall closure vs plain XL (refutation degree)
mechanism: At each Macaulay degree D the degree<=D XL row space is put in reduced echelon form; every fall row g (deg g < D, linear falls included) is multiplied by every monomial t with deg t <= D - deg g over the occurring variables, absorbed, repeated to saturation. Refuted iff 1 is in the saturated space. Products stay in the ideal, so closure degree <= XL degree.
curve_family: binary Koblitz E0: y^2+xy=x^3+1 over GF(2^n) (ECC2K-130 family, b=1); chained S3 decomposition (m-2 intermediate x-coords), random F2-subspace factor base V of dim l; Weil descent to F2, Boolean/multilinear (field equations x^2=x built in). N=(m-2)n+m*l unknowns, (m-1)n equations, surplus S=n-m*l.
measured_outcomes: closure refutes at 3 on 16 draws and 4 on 76 (92/92), every closure saturated; XL 5-7 (>=7 at m=4 l=3). Gap XL-closure: 26 draws by 1, 58 by >=2 (3 where XL=7). m=3 closure median 4 at every l=2..5 while XL goes 5->7. Closure matrix 2^1-2^7 narrower (log2 cols at closure deg 9.1-15.3 vs at XL deg 10.0->=22.1); closure products ~cols^1.2, word ops ~cols^2.2 (m=4 (10,3): 2^15.3 cols, 2^17.8 products, 2^33.8 word ops). Totals over 92 draws: closure_products 4,902,150; closure_rank sum 60,470; xl_rank sum 165,625. Run 4 min 15 s, slowest degree 39 s, peak 1.0 GB. XL-identity assertion held 92/92. Soundness control: 0/345 satisfiable draws refuted (built to degree 5). Constructed control: closure 3, XL 4.
vs_baseline: XL on identical systems: lowered by 1-3 degrees on every draw (20/20 testable cells + 3 exploratory).
vs_semiregular: far below: semi-regular D_reg of these shapes is 5-9 (e.g. m=3 (10,5) 7, m=4 (10,3) 9); closure reads 3-4.
verdict: lowers
tier_rationale: single registered run with full raw records, plus independent corroboration on the same committed draws: external msolve 0.6.5 F4 reads max step degree 3-4 on 48 of them (ic_next10_20261014/06), and on the 7 m=4 l<=2 cells its per-draw sequence equals the closure's draw for draw (28 draws, 10 of them at 3; e.g. (5,2) '4 4 3 3' in both tables); the in-repo sparse_closure_refutes (no shared code beyond the row builder) matches the dense closure on 36 small comparisons.

Satisfiable control added after scoring (disclosed). Q2 ('one degree, not more') and Q3 ('growth with l survives') refuted.
